name: Up-shine Lighting Co., Limited
summary: Up-shine Lighting Co., Limited engages in the research and development, production, and sale of LED lighting products in China and internationally. The company offers commercial lighting products, such as design downlight, SMD LED ceiling light, and COB LED adjustable track light; industrial and mining lamps, streetlight, and explosion-proof light; and emergency lighting products, such as emergency signs, emergency indicator light, and emergency drive.
